strategic.name: Customer Service & Advisory
strategic.definition: How customers experience reaching, interacting with, and being followed up by support staff and advisors across all contact channels.

midlevel.name: Support responsiveness & follow-up
midlevel.definition: How quickly, reliably, and completely support answers customer inquiries and honors promised follow-ups.

specific.name: Reply speed across contact channels
specific.definition: How quickly the bank replies to emails, calls, and chat messages, from answers within minutes to many days of silence.

specific.name: Callback and follow-up reliability
specific.definition: Whether promised callbacks, status follow-ups, and agreed next steps actually happen or never materialize.

specific.name: Answer accuracy and completeness
specific.definition: Whether responses are correct, complete, and consistent, versus half-answers, wrong information, or cases left open.

midlevel.name: Access to support
midlevel.definition: How easy it is for customers to reach a human who can help when they need assistance.

specific.name: Reaching support and waiting times
specific.definition: Ease of getting through to support, including phone queues, chat availability outside office hours, and general accessibility.

specific.name: Chatbot support and escalation to human staff
specific.definition: How well the chatbot resolves issues and whether customers can reach a human when the chatbot falls short.

midlevel.name: Advisor quality & relationship continuity
midlevel.definition: The competence, conduct, and continuity of advisors and contact persons over the course of the relationship.

specific.name: Advisor competence and business understanding
specific.definition: Whether advisors know the rules, understand the customer's business, and give tailored, solution-oriented advice.

specific.name: Contact person continuity and handover quality
specific.definition: Whether customers keep the same contact person over time or face advisor turnover, repeated information requests, and poor handovers.

specific.name: Professionalism and advisory orientation of staff
specific.definition: Whether interactions feel friendly, proactive, and genuinely advisory rather than pushy or sales-driven.

strategic.name: Pricing & Contract Terms
strategic.definition: How customers perceive the level, transparency, and predictability of rates, fees, and contractual conditions.

midlevel.name: Interest rates & total cost
midlevel.definition: Perceived level, competitiveness, and explanation of interest rates and the overall price of financing.

specific.name: Rate level and competitiveness
specific.definition: How high or competitive business credit and savings rates are perceived, including comparisons with competitors.

specific.name: Advertised vs actual rates and pricing
specific.definition: Whether quoted or advertised 'from' rates and calculator figures match the final offer and agreement.

specific.name: Clarity of interest calculation and rate explanations
specific.definition: Whether interest calculation, effective rates, and total financing costs are clearly explained.

midlevel.name: Fees & charges
midlevel.definition: The size, clarity, and predictability of fees charged on accounts and financing.

specific.name: Fee level and structure clarity
specific.definition: The size, number, and clarity of establishment, instalment, administration, and recurring monthly fees.

specific.name: Fee predictability and disputed charges
specific.definition: Whether fees arrive as expected or appear as hidden, unexpected, or duplicate charges that customers dispute.

midlevel.name: Contract terms & changes
midlevel.definition: Transparency and fairness of binding periods, exit conditions, and changes to rates or credit terms.

specific.name: Lock-in periods and termination costs
specific.definition: Experiences with binding periods, notice of lock-in terms, break fees, and obstacles when ending an agreement early.

specific.name: Notice of rate and credit-term changes
specific.definition: Whether rate increases and changes to credit terms are announced with reasonable notice and explanation or made without warning.

strategic.name: Digital Experience & Technology
strategic.definition: How well the bank's digital channels — portal, app, login, and integrations — work for everyday business banking.

midlevel.name: Platform reliability & access
midlevel.definition: Stability, speed, and availability of the portal, mobile app, and login.

specific.name: Portal and app stability, speed, and uptime
specific.definition: Whether the portal and app run fast and reliably, covering crashes, session timeouts, lost form data, portal hangs, and how quickly reported bugs are fixed.

specific.name: Login and BankID reliability
specific.definition: Whether logging in, including with BankID, works smoothly or fails.

specific.name: Mobile app availability
specific.definition: Whether a mobile app exists and offers sufficient functionality, including applying or managing services from mobile.

midlevel.name: Self-service functionality & data
midlevel.definition: Whether customers can perform everyday tasks themselves in the portal and trust the data shown.

specific.name: Everyday self-service tasks in the portal
specific.definition: Ease of finding functions and handling routine tasks such as changing account numbers, terminating credit lines, or uploading documents.

specific.name: Balance and statement accuracy
specific.definition: Whether displayed balances, statements, and invoice data are correct and trustworthy.

specific.name: Data export and reporting
specific.definition: Ability to download statements, CSV files, and invoice data for accounting and reporting.

specific.name: User and accountant access management
specific.definition: Granularity of user access controls and ease of giving accountants or employees access.

midlevel.name: Integrations & automation
midlevel.definition: How well the bank connects with external accounting systems and automates routine financial flows.

specific.name: Accounting software integration reliability
specific.definition: Whether integrations with accounting systems such as Bokfør work reliably or fail.

specific.name: Automation of invoice posting and payments
specific.definition: Degree of automation in invoice posting, monthly direct debits, and other routine payments without manual effort.

strategic.name: Speed & Process Efficiency
strategic.definition: How quickly and smoothly applications, credit decisions, payouts, and routine changes are completed.

midlevel.name: Application & onboarding
midlevel.definition: Ease and speed of applying and getting started with the bank.

specific.name: Application ease and simplicity
specific.definition: How simple and clear the application and setup process is, including digital signing and mobile application.

specific.name: Documentation requirements and automated data retrieval
specific.definition: The volume of paperwork demanded versus automatic retrieval of figures and smooth document handling.

midlevel.name: Credit decisions & case processing
midlevel.definition: Turnaround time for credit assessments, approvals, and ongoing case handling.

specific.name: Credit assessment and approval speed
specific.definition: How fast credit decisions are made, from instant weekend approvals to multi-week rejections.

specific.name: Processing speed vs advertised promises
specific.definition: How actual processing times compare with marketing promises such as 'same-day' handling.

specific.name: Routine change and case processing time
specific.definition: How quickly routine changes, such as account number updates, and open cases are completed.

midlevel.name: Payout & funding speed
midlevel.definition: How quickly approved funds reach the customer's account.

specific.name: Time from approval to payout
specific.definition: How quickly loan and credit payouts reach the customer's account after approval.

specific.name: Invoice financing payout speed and liquidity effect
specific.definition: How fast funds are paid out after an invoice is submitted or sold, and the resulting effect on liquidity, payroll, and day-to-day operations.

strategic.name: Communication, Transparency & Trust
strategic.definition: Whether the bank communicates proactively and clearly, and keeps the commitments it makes.

midlevel.name: Proactive communication & status updates
midlevel.definition: Whether customers are kept informed without having to chase the bank.

specific.name: Status updates during processing
specific.definition: Whether customers receive timely updates on application and case status instead of silence.

specific.name: Proactive outreach and information sharing
specific.definition: Whether the bank and advisors reach out proactively with relevant information and follow-ups.

midlevel.name: Clarity of terms & decisions
midlevel.definition: How clearly and consistently terms, agreements, and decisions are communicated.

specific.name: Clarity and consistency of terms and agreements
specific.definition: Whether interest rates, agreement terms, and conditions are communicated clearly, consistently, and without contradictions.

specific.name: Explanation and justification of credit decisions
specific.definition: Whether approvals and rejections come with understandable reasons, including openness about credit assessments.

midlevel.name: Honesty & commitment follow-through
midlevel.definition: Whether the bank stands by what it promises in writing, verbally, and in marketing.

specific.name: Honoring written and verbal commitments
specific.definition: Whether the bank stands by written or verbal credit commitments and promises made during the process.

specific.name: Accuracy of marketing and eligibility expectations
specific.definition: Whether marketing sets realistic expectations about who qualifies and what is offered, versus attracting applicants who are then declined.

strategic.name: Product Fit, Flexibility & Eligibility
strategic.definition: Whether the bank's credit products, terms, and criteria genuinely fit the needs of small businesses.

midlevel.name: Product fit for small businesses
midlevel.definition: How well products, limits, and configurations match the size and industry of the business.

specific.name: Product usefulness for business size and industry
specific.definition: Whether overdraft, invoice financing, tax loans, and other products genuinely serve the cash-flow needs of different business sizes and industries.

specific.name: Credit limits and facility configuration options
specific.definition: Whether credit limits, loan amount caps, and facility configurations such as multiple overdrafts fit the company's needs.

specific.name: Treatment of micro-companies relative to larger clients
specific.definition: Whether micro-businesses are taken as seriously as larger clients.

midlevel.name: Repayment flexibility & hardship support
midlevel.definition: The bank's willingness to adapt repayment when business conditions change.

specific.name: Payment deferrals and adjusted repayment plans
specific.definition: Willingness to grant deferrals and adjust repayment schedules when businesses face difficulties.

specific.name: Season-adapted repayment structures
specific.definition: Whether repayment plans can be adapted to seasonal fluctuations in the business.

midlevel.name: Eligibility & credit criteria
midlevel.definition: The rules determining who qualifies for financing and on what terms.

specific.name: Qualification and creditworthiness criteria
specific.definition: Who qualifies for financing and credit lines, including rejections based on credit scores or business type.

specific.name: Invoice acceptance rules
specific.definition: Which invoices are accepted for financing, including rules on end-customer creditworthiness and B2C sales.

specific.name: Credit limit changes at renewal
specific.definition: Whether credit limits are maintained, reduced, or withdrawn at renewal.

strategic.name: Billing & Account Administration
strategic.definition: Correctness of billing and the handling of account closure and related administration.

midlevel.name: Billing accuracy
midlevel.definition: Whether invoices and charges issued to customers are correct.

specific.name: Billing and invoice accuracy
specific.definition: Correctness of invoices, including duplicate charges, wrong amounts, wrong due dates, and surprise invoice items.

midlevel.name: Account closure & exit administration
midlevel.definition: How smoothly account termination and related administration are handled.

specific.name: Account termination process and post-closure billing
specific.definition: The effort required to close an account and whether billing stops correctly afterwards, including delayed terminations and post-closure invoices.
